verdict.rationale: OpenAI Agents SDK is itself an official first-party SDK (Python and JS) with extensive documentation covering core primitives (agents, tools, handoffs, guardrails, tracing, sessions, streaming, MCP support, voice/realtime), and is corroborated by GitHub repo docs and community usage reports confirming real-world adoption. Missing for 10: deeper independent third-party production case studies beyond a couple of HN threads.
